texts.Die Android-App ist entfallen – die Web-: The Android app is gone – the web app runs the same on every phone (Android, iPhone), without an app store or developer verification, future-proof. New with five tabs (Services, Players, Tasks, Log, More), “Install as app”, home-screen shortcuts and web push.

Security check (weak, reused, leaked, no 2FA), TOTP, generator, history, trash. Browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox straight from Hostwerk (fill in, save, generator). Provider programs updated with a trial run, service catalog online, the AI never sees passwords.

Settings in seven sections, drag images from the media library into the chat, Ctrl+V everywhere, test image for local models, the German voice stays German.

texts.Ein Jahr ohne dich – und zehn: A year without you – and ten
texts.Protokolle rotieren, der Speicher wird ü: Logs rotate, disk space is watched, backups run out of the box, extensions update themselves and problems report in bundles. Checked by time travel over 1, 3, 5 and 10 years.

texts.Abfragen mit Zeitlimit und Abbrechen, Be: Queries with time limit and cancel, user rights by form, SQLite, EXPLAIN as a graph, sync SQL, CSV/Excel import, read-only, SSH tunnel and restoring single tables from backups. Major version upgrades for PostgreSQL and MongoDB with a test copy.

Several hundred probes against real programs (Apache, nginx, Caddy, PHP, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, IMAP, SFTP) – the bugs found on the way are fixed.
